subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should #87711 remain the umbrella for reset/session durability and Telegram delivery diagnostics, or should maintainers split the remaining work into #77871, #87744, #90091, #87327, and a new warm-reset UX issue?
rationale: The issue now mixes proven runtime invariants with product/UX asks, and automation cannot safely decide whether to keep a broad umbrella open or require each sub-surface to close through narrower canonical trackers.

options.title: Keep umbrella, split implementation
options.body: Leave #87711 open as the cross-surface tracker, but require each PR to target a narrow invariant or sub-issue before closure.

options.title: Move all work to canonicals
options.body: Close #87711 only after filing or updating the narrower canonical issues for every remaining ask and linking the durable reset-binding acceptance criteria there.

options.title: Sponsor one broad reliability pass
options.body: Treat #87711 as a single maintainer-owned project covering reset durability, self-heal, delivery diagnostics, and reset UX in one coordinated branch.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella, split implementation
recommendation.body: Leave #87711 open as the cross-surface tracker, but require each PR to target a narrow invariant or sub-issue before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the strongest current routing owner from recent mainline blame/log and broad session/channel architecture history.
